{"findings": [{"file": "tools.py", "line_start": 10, "line_end": 10, "owasp": "LLM10", "title": "Calculator evaluates model output with eval()", "excerpt": "return str(eval(llm_reply))", "likelihood": 4, "impact": 5, "fix": "Parse arithmetic with an ast whitelist; never eval model text."}, {"file": "tools.py", "line_start": 24, "line_end": 24, "owasp": "LLM10", "title": "Model answer interpolated into a shell command", "excerpt": "subprocess.run(f\"echo {answer} >> transcripts.log\", shell=True)", "likelihood": 4, "impact": 5, "fix": "Write transcripts with file I/O; never pass model output to a shell."}, {"file": "tools.py", "line_start": 1, "line_end": 1, "owasp": "LLM10", "title": "Model output deserialised with pickle", "excerpt": "pickle.loads(llm_reply)", "likelihood": 4, "impact": 5, "fix": "Never unpickle untrusted data."}]}
